Cmp (M) No. 480 of 2023 in Rfa No. 2 of 2011

This application has been filed for substitution of
deceased respondent No. 1 Narata Ram through his legal heirs mentioned in para 2 of the
application, who are Smt. Shakuntla Devi and Smt. Kanta Devi (widows of late Narata Ram) and
Netar Singh (son of late Narata Ram).

It has been submitted that as per family register Shakuntla Devi and Kanta Devi were wives of
deceased Narata Ram, however, for having complete instructions after verifying the facts, matter is
adjourned with direction to respective counsel for parties to ascertain the status of Shakuntla Devi
and Kanta Devi qua their right to be substituted in place of deceased Narata Ram.

Needful be done
within two weeks.
List for consideration on 18th July, 2023.

of 2010 These applications have been filed for substitution of deceased appellant No. 1 Nanak Chand
through legal heirs/sons, namely, Ajay Singh and Kalyan Singh.

Nanak Chand indicating that the said appellant has expired on 12.10.2021, has been placed on
record.
Copy of legal heirs certificate has also been placed on record, indicating that deceased Nanak
Chand is survived by his legal heirs Bhago .
Devi (mother), Shakuntla Devi (wife), Pushpa Devi (daughter), Ajay Singh and Kalyan Singh (sons).

Alongwith applications copy of mutation has also been placed on record, whereby entire estate of
the deceased appellant has devolved upon his sons Ajay Singh and Kalyan Singh, on the basis of
settlement between the parties and all other legal heirs have relinquished their shares in favour of
two sons of deceased Nanak Chand.
No objection has been communicated for allowing the applications.

Accordingly, deceased appellant No. 1 is permitted to be substituted through Ajay Singh and Kalyan
Singh as appellants No. 1(a) and 1(b) respectively, after condoning the delay and setting aside
abatement, if any.
The applications stand disposed of.

r It has been further submitted that at the time of filing appeal he had contacted the Advocate

It has further been submitted
